title: Scalar-compatible descent of the identity-compactification comparison
statement:
Fix the finite-field datum $(p,a,q,k_0,k)$ of [def-weil-finite-field-fiber], a prime $\ell\ne p$, and an algebraic closure $\Omega=\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$. Let $E\subset\Omega$ be a finite extension of $\mathbf Q_\ell$, with valuation ring $R=\mathcal O_E$, uniformizer $t=\varpi_E$, and $A_n=R/t^n$ for $n\ge1$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Let $X,Y$ be separated finite-type $k$-schemes and $f:X\to Y$ a proper $k$-morphism [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties, def-weil-proper-morphism]. Use the small pro-etale sites, finite constructible categories, derived direct images and compact-support candidates of [def-compact-support-direct-image-detailed, def-weil-derived-direct-image]. Write $c_0=(\operatorname{id}_X,f)$ for the identity compactification [def-weil-compactifications-refinements].

Allow $E$ to vary over all finite subfields of $\Omega$. At each stage suppose given the integral natural isomorphism $\theta_E:Rf_!^{c_0}\xrightarrow{\sim}Rf_*$ on $D^b_c(X,\mathcal O_E)$, from the integral compact-support value at $c_0$ of [def-weil-integral-rational-qbar-compact-support] to the integral derived direct image of [def-weil-derived-direct-image], whose components are induced, term by term on the defining quotient towers $\operatorname{Res}_nRf_{!,n}^{c_0}K_n$ and $\operatorname{Res}_nRf_{*,n}K_n$, by $\operatorname{Res}_nRf_{*,n}$ of the sectionwise identity identifications $(\operatorname{id}_X)_!\xrightarrow{\sim}\operatorname{id}$ of extension by zero [def-weil-extension-by-zero], and which preserves their chosen derived-limit projections. Use the normalized integral and rational compact-support actions of [def-weil-compact-support-finite-action], their coefficient actions of [def-weil-compact-support-coefficient-action], and the ordinary derived-direct-image actions of [def-weil-derived-direct-image]. Let $T^W_{L/E}$ be completed integral scalar extension for $W=X,Y$, and let
$$b_!:T^Y_{L/E}Rf_{!,E}^{c_0}\xrightarrow{\sim}Rf_{!,L}^{c_0}T^X_{L/E},\qquad b_*:T^Y_{L/E}Rf_{*,E}\xrightarrow{\sim}Rf_{*,L}T^X_{L/E}$$
be their specified scalar comparisons, with identity and successive-extension identifications. Here $b_*$ is the inverse of the integral comparison of [lem-sf-strict-direct-image-scalar-comparison], namely the ambient completed-ring counit/tensor comparison transported through the normalized strict-tower reconstruction and ordinary-to-completed scalar identifications; it is not an independently chosen scalar isomorphism. Then
$$b_*\circ T^Y_{L/E}(\theta_E)=(\theta_LT^X_{L/E})\circ b_!.$$
The integral $\theta_E$ and its inverse induce a natural isomorphism $\theta_E^{\mathrm{rat}}:Rf_{!,E}^{c_0}\cong Rf_{*,E}$ on the raw rationalized categories of [def-weil-rationalization-karoubi], natural for every finite sum $\sum_j u_j\otimes a_j$ of morphism tensors. Its components at $(E,K_E)$ define a natural isomorphism $\theta_\Omega:Rf_{!,\Omega}^{c_0}\cong Rf_{*,\Omega}$ on the common-stage pair categories of [def-weil-algebraically-closed-coefficients]: its component is represented by $\theta_E^{\mathrm{rat}}(K_E)$, and the naturality equation for a morphism represented over $L\supset E,E'$ holds over that same $L$ and is preserved by every further finite extension. The resulting comparison is independent of the representative of the morphism and of replacing an object by its canonical scalar-extension presentation.

proof.text: Apply the integral identity-open scalar square [lem-weil-proper-integral-scalar-square] to D, its laws, S, theta and the two given normalization predicates. The unchanged normalization predicates are shared through [def-weil-proper-coefficient-descent-data].

The compact rational action is literally tensor extension of its integral functor. Whisker theta with target rationalization and compose the ordinary localization comparison inverse. The fully faithful raw-localization precomposition of [lem-real-raw-localization-natural-iso] produces the rational natural isomorphisms. Their forward components are the localized theta by the normalization of R.localization, and uniqueness of inverse gives the asserted inverse components.

Construct the ordinary stage-system morphism from R.rational and inverse R.theta. Cancel the ordinary comparisons in HasComparisonLaws to obtain its associator equation, and transport this system along the unique equality with the recorded stage system. Use [lem-weil-proper-rational-scalar-square] to prove compatibility of the rational isomorphisms with beta.

Form compatible transformation families from r.hom and r.inv; the inverse compatibility follows by cancellation. Descend the two families with StageSystem.Morphism.descNatIso. Its component formulas are the stage inclusions. Hom.mapAt_naturality supplies same-stage naturality and, applied to the transported arrow, further-stage naturality. Naturality of the descended transformation at isoToStage proves presentation independence.

proof_origin.place: First paragraph; integral scalar square followed by raw rationalization and the existing StageSystem transformation descent.
